tasks.prompt: Review the code in fixtures/purposes/review/ and write your findings to fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md, one finding per line with the line number. Do not change the source. Do not run git.
gate: test -s fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md || { echo 'REVIEW.md is missing or empty'; exit 1; }

grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(9|1[0-5])([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md | grep -qiE '(off[- ]by[- ]one|out of range|bounds|<=|panic)' || { echo 'review does not identify the off-by-one at line 11'; exit 1; }

grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(1[89]|2[01])([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md | grep -qiE '(unchecked|ignor|unhandled|missing error|lack|(not|never|n.t)( being)? (check|handl)|dropped|discard|swallow|thrown away|blank identifier|no error[- ]check(s|ing)? (on|for|of))' || { echo 'review does not identify the unchecked error at line 19'; exit 1; }

grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(2[4-9]|3[0-6])([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/purposes/review/REVIEW.md | grep -qiE '(\brace\b|concurrent|\block\b|\bmutex\b|unsynchroni)' || { echo 'review does not identify the race at line 31'; exit 1; }
git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/purposes/review/review.go || { echo 'review.go was changed'; exit 1; }

tasks.prompt: Review the code in fixtures/real/review-idle/idle.go and write your findings to fixtures/real/review-idle/REVIEW.md, one finding per line with its line number. Do not change the source. Do not run git.
gate: test -s fixtures/real/review-idle/REVIEW.md || { echo 'fixtures/real/review-idle/REVIEW.md is missing or empty'; exit 1; }

[ -n "$(grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(17|18|19|20|21)([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/real/review-idle/REVIEW.md | grep -iE '(negative|future|after now|ahead|clock|resolution|skew|clamp|below zero|less than (zero|0)|< ?0)')" ] || { echo 'the review does not find the negative age at line 19'; exit 1; }

[ -n "$(grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(29|30|31|32|33)([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/real/review-idle/REVIEW.md | grep -iE '(negative|future|after now|ahead|clock|resolution|skew|clamp|below zero|less than (zero|0)|< ?0|same|likewise|as (on |at |in )?line 19)')" ] || { echo 'the review does not find the same negative age at line 31'; exit 1; }
git diff --quiet HEAD -- fixtures/real/review-idle/idle.go || { echo 'idle.go was changed'; exit 1; }

[ -n "$(grep -iE '(^|[^0-9])(62|63|64|65|66|67|68|69|70|71|80|81|82|83|84|85|98|99|100|143|144|145)([^0-9]|$)' fixtures/real/review-retry/REVIEW.md | grep -iE '(too long|ErrTooLong|1 ?MiB|oversiz|limit|buffer|large|huge|long line)' | grep -iE '(retr|again|reconnect|loop|forever|for ever|repeat|30|refetch|re-fetch)')" ] || { echo 'the review does not find that Watch retries an oversized event line instead of stopping'; exit 1; }
